benchmarks.name: SWE-Bench Verified
benchmarks.shortDescription: Real-world GitHub issue resolution in production codebases. Gold standard for practical software engineering.

nonTechnical.title: Plain English
nonTechnical.content: This benchmark tests if an AI can fix actual bugs from real GitHub projects, like a professional developer would. It requires understanding large codebases, planning changes, and producing working fixes.

intermediate.title: Intermediate
intermediate.content: SWE-Bench Verified consists of ~500 human-verified GitHub issues. Models must edit code across files to resolve them. High scores indicate strong repository-level reasoning, debugging, and code generation capabilities.

expert.title: Expert / Research-Level
expert.content: Evaluates agentic coding with full context. Top models now exceed 80% resolution rate (v2.0 agent setups). Still distinguishes frontier systems due to multi-step planning, error recovery, and handling of dependencies. Contamination-resistant compared to synthetic coding tests.

scores.note: High reasoning mode; leads or ties many evaluations
Approximate; strong on related Pro variant
Reported leadership in some raw SWE-bench runs

benchmarks.name: GPQA Diamond
benchmarks.shortDescription: PhD-level science questions designed to be Google-proof and extremely difficult.

nonTechnical.title: Plain English
nonTechnical.content: Extremely hard graduate-level science questions that even experts struggle with. Tests deep understanding rather than memorized facts.

intermediate.title: Intermediate
intermediate.content: 198 challenging questions in biology, chemistry, physics, etc. PhD experts score ~65%; non-experts with search score much lower. Requires multi-step reasoning and domain expertise.

expert.title: Expert / Research-Level
expert.content: One of the few remaining discriminative reasoning benchmarks. Top models approach 90-94% with thinking modes, but gaps persist in true generalization vs. pattern matching.

benchmarks.name: LiveCodeBench
benchmarks.shortDescription: Contamination-free coding problems from ongoing competitive programming contests.

nonTechnical.title: Plain English
nonTechnical.content: Fresh coding challenges that change regularly so AIs can't just memorize answers. Tests real problem-solving ability.

intermediate.title: Intermediate
intermediate.content: Evaluates code generation and algorithmic thinking on new contest problems. Includes self-repair and multiple languages.

expert.title: Expert / Research-Level
expert.content: Strong signal for algorithmic capability. Top models reach 85-91% on recent versions; distinguishes models better than saturated HumanEval-style tests.

scores.note: From LiveBench-related coding average; competitive in broader evals

benchmarks.name: Humanity's Last Exam (HLE)
benchmarks.shortDescription: 2,500 expert-level multi-modal questions across 100+ subjects at the frontier of human knowledge.

nonTechnical.title: Plain English
nonTechnical.content: An incredibly tough 'final exam' of academic questions designed to challenge even the smartest AIs across science, math, humanities, and more.

intermediate.title: Intermediate
intermediate.content: Broad coverage with held-out private test set to prevent overfitting. Tests depth of reasoning and knowledge integration rather than narrow memorization.

expert.title: Expert / Research-Level
expert.content: Intended as a durable frontier benchmark. Current top scores ~35-53% (with tools); highlights remaining gaps in true expert-level understanding.

benchmarks.name: ARC-AGI-2
benchmarks.shortDescription: Abstract reasoning puzzles testing core intelligence and generalization (non-memorizable).

nonTechnical.title: Plain English
nonTechnical.content: Visual and abstract puzzles that require genuine novel reasoning, not just pattern recall from training data.

intermediate.title: Intermediate
intermediate.content: Measures fluid intelligence through grid-based transformation tasks. Pure LLMs previously scored near 0%; multimodal versions show progress.

expert.title: Expert / Research-Level
expert.content: Strong signal for AGI-like abstraction. Top models now reach 60-77% on v2; interactive v3 expected to raise the bar further.

benchmarks.name: LMSYS Chatbot Arena (Elo)
benchmarks.shortDescription: Crowdsourced blind human preference battles for overall conversational quality.

nonTechnical.title: Plain English
nonTechnical.content: Real users vote on which AI gives better answers in anonymous chats. Reflects practical usefulness and 'vibes'.

intermediate.title: Intermediate
intermediate.content: Elo rating system from thousands of pairwise comparisons. Covers helpfulness, coherence, creativity, and instruction following.

expert.title: Expert / Research-Level
expert.content: Robust human-aligned metric less prone to benchmark gaming. Top models cluster tightly around 1490-1505 Elo in 2026.

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench 2.0
benchmarks.shortDescription: Autonomous terminal and DevOps tasks in real shell environments.

nonTechnical.title: Plain English
nonTechnical.content: Tests if an AI can use the command line like a sysadmin or engineer to complete practical tasks.

intermediate.title: Intermediate
intermediate.content: Realistic workflows involving environment setup, scripting, debugging, and tool use in a terminal.

expert.title: Expert / Research-Level
expert.content: Strong agentic signal beyond pure code generation. Highlights differences in planning, tool calling reliability, and execution feedback loops.

benchmarks.name: MMLU-Pro
benchmarks.shortDescription: Enhanced graduate-level multi-choice questions across many subjects (harder successor to original MMLU).

nonTechnical.title: Plain English
nonTechnical.content: Tough multiple-choice test covering advanced knowledge in science, humanities, law, and more.

intermediate.title: Intermediate
intermediate.content: More reasoning-heavy than basic MMLU, with 10 options per question to reduce guessing.

expert.title: Expert / Research-Level
expert.content: Still useful for broad knowledge assessment but increasingly saturated at the frontier (>90% for top models).
